sections.content: How many people are "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors"?

141,960 people

were counted on the census as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors co-ordinate the catering services of restaurants, hotels and large-scale catering services within other organisations.

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors", 15.2% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" included:

  • dispensing opticians
  • travel agents
  • quality assurance technicians

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" there were more men than women (55.5% compared with 44.5%).

This means "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 55.5% and women made up 44.5% of "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" included:

  • barristers and judges
  • biological scientists
  • betting shop and gambling establishment managers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

The percentage of men and women who are "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors", 7.6% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (71.2% compared with 28.8%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (68.7%) than self-employed (31.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
